title: Robert Hastings exposes Bill Moore's intelligence connections
summary: Richard Dolan tells of Robert Hastings exposes Bill Moore's intelligence connections, about late 1980s-1989 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and it was Robert Hastings, by the way, who in my opinion is probably more than anyone else responsible for the takedown of Bill Moore.

plain: Richard Dolan, a UFO historian, says that in the late 1980s a researcher named Robert Hastings did more than anyone to bring down Bill Moore, another UFO researcher who had ties to intelligence officials. According to Dolan, Hastings made his case in the journals of MUFON, the Mutual UFO Network, a large civilian group that investigates UFO reports. The story matters because it suggests intelligence agencies were working through people inside the UFO research world.
